ns2:section.sectionText: DESIGN LIKE A PHYSICIST Becoming the fearless toolsmith: you will address a real-world problem with your physicist’s insight and the tools of electrical and mechanical engineers. There will be IDEs and PCBs and 3-D printers, and a treat bag at the end of the course.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Engineering Physics or Physics or Teaching of Physics major(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
